title: Recent-Increase Hold at Cut-Off — Group Room Blocks
content:
**Ruling.** At the cut-off release of a Group Room Blocks rooming-list block a recent-increase hold is kept back from the release. It follows when the block's latest signed increase addendum was issued, counted in calendar days before the cut-off date:

- issued **no more than 30** calendar days before the cut-off date: **0.5** of the room nights of the block's increase entries, rounded down;
- issued **more than 30 but no more than 60** calendar days before the cut-off date: **0.25** of them, rounded down;
- issued earlier, or the block has no signed increase addendum: none.

**Records read.** The issue date of the block's most recently issued increase addendum whose status is signed, and the room nights of the increase entries on the block ledger.

### Worked holds (hypothetical block whose increase entries total 26 room nights)

| Latest signed increase addendum issued, before the cut-off date | Share | Hold kept back |
|---|---|---|
| 20 days | one half | 13 |
| 30 days | one half | 13 |
| 31 days | one quarter | 6 (6.5 rounded down) |
| 60 days | one quarter | 6 |
| 61 days | — | none |
